name: normal_textbook_one_sample_z
description: One-sample z test, Cohen's d=0.5, alpha=0.05 two-sided, 80% power. Textbook unrounded n=31.36; the minimal INTEGER n that actually reaches 80% is n=32 (power 0.80743), while n=31 gives 0.79501 and fails.

reference.provenance: Direct scipy.stats.norm evaluation, independently of ssp.kernels
